handback.title: The settings stop declaring the plan and work labels
handback.summary: The settings drop the old plan and work labels, which nothing reads since commands replaced them.
handback.user_story: The settings no longer list the old plan and work labels, so no repo is asked to create them.

acceptance_criteria.text: The settings no longer declare the old plan label.

acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed entry in plain data; there is no input, call or failure to vary.
